written_sentences.note: Written where Tatoeba has fewer than two usable sentences for a word; machine-written, not native-reviewed; no audio.

dictionary_hindi_twin.source: kaikki.org Hindi Wiktionary extract, entries with an Urdu spelling (glosses and romanisation for Urdu words the Urdu extract lacks)

story_sentences.source: Let's Read Asia (The Asia Foundation), Urdu books with their English edition
story_sentences.note: Sentences are split out of the book text, Urdu and English realigned sentence by sentence; typographic quotes became plain, nothing else was changed.
